[[File:R2-D2_Breakdance.jpg|thumb|right|150px|[[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] breakdancing in front of a jukebox.]]
A '''jukebox''' was a device that played [[Music/Legends|music]]. At least some models were designed so that the user could insert [[jukebox token]]s into the machine and then select from a catalog of songs.<ref name="TOR" /> Jukeboxes were commonly found in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SW:G">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] [[Breakdance|danced]] in front of a jukebox in a cantina on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manda/Legends|Manda]].<ref name="TOTRC">{{DroidsCite|Tail of the Roon Comets}}</ref>
